name: Atsinganosaurus
sum: Atsinganosaurus is a titanosaur from the Gres a Reptiles Formation of the Aix-en-Provence Basin, France, described in 2010.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Excavated in 2009-2010; held at the University of Poitiers.
material: Further specimens include an occipital condyle (MMS/VBN.09.41).
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Garcia et al. 2010
